integrity_rules: Do not edit the frozen Reality campaign, its plan, pinned code, labels, assumptions, or journal.
Keep public observations, derived measurements, estimated quantities, hypothetical execution, and unknown fills separate.
Do not promote candidates from a single selected panel or repeatedly reused confirmation data.
All source and campaign reads in the initial audit were read-only; no orders were submitted.
Source replay uses finalized cataloged segments only and never reads the active .open segment.

hypotheses.title: Separate invalid initial decisions from later follow-up censoring
hypotheses.mechanism: The reported censored total combines outcomes for invalid initial books with outcomes that had a valid initial state but lacked a synchronized qualifying future book.
hypotheses.success_metric: Classify every selected follow-up by frozen initial-state quality, outcome horizon, public censor reason, and pending status without changing source records.
limitations: The original campaign is one prospective selected cohort and one UTC day at this snapshot.
A synchronized public observation is not an execution or fill label.
No historical label or campaign rule was changed.
hypotheses.decision: Continue source-level diagnosis. Consider alternative predeclared horizons and quality-aware decision sampling only in a new campaign.

hypotheses.title: Universal abstention is supported by the observed decision-time funnel
hypotheses.mechanism: If eligible initial states have no positive top-of-book complementary discrepancy, relaxing policy thresholds or adding model complexity cannot create a supported same-condition arbitrage.
hypotheses.success_metric: Report the full valid-state pre-fee edge distribution and matched action/reason counts for all frozen policies.
limitations: The panel is bounded and not representative of the entire venue.
The distribution is pre-fee and does not identify an execution result.
No evidence supports relaxing timing, quality, fee, or risk gates.
hypotheses.decision: Keep no-trade as the honest current decision. Investigate market coverage and sampling before considering strategy threshold changes.

hypotheses.title: A single fee-rounding quantum per leg does not bound unknown match fragmentation
hypotheses.mechanism: The Reality scenario reserve adds one 0.00001 quantum to an unrounded fee per leg. With unknown match fragmentation, individually rounded match fees can exceed that reserve.
hypotheses.success_metric: Use exact displayed price-level costs, preserve market-specific fee inputs, and ensure the unknown-fragmentation fee upper bound dominates tested rounded partitions without claiming fills.

result.promotion: not promoted; requires independent economic review and live evidence remains unavailable

limitations: The fee rate and quantity in this example are controlled inputs, not a market observation.
The upper bound is deliberately conservative and does not estimate actual fee fragmentation.
The Reality campaign and legacy economic function were not modified.
hypotheses.decision: Retain the new engine as a versioned Veritas research candidate. Compare its arithmetic independently before downstream strategy use.

hypotheses.title: Activity-aware, quality-aware sampling can improve future public label coverage
hypotheses.mechanism: A frozen cadence conditioned on independently measured market activity and synchronized book quality may yield more valid future public measurements per decision without loosening original campaign gates.
hypotheses.success_metric: Compare eligible-state fraction and measured follow-up fraction by market family and predeclared activity stratum; retain an all-market control and no-trade baseline.
limitations: Selection on activity changes the target population and must remain visible.
A larger observed-label fraction does not establish better execution or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: A design-only proposal is documented in docs/VERITAS_GATE_A_FOLLOWUP_DESIGN_001.md. Before any prospective run, refine the eligible-universe coverage rule, assignment schedule, and cluster-aware power plan; any run must use a new campaign identity and leave Reality unchanged.

hypotheses.title: Sampled campaign decisions reproduce from finalized public source records
hypotheses.mechanism: If the frozen decision journal is consistent with its immutable source prefix, its indexed decisions should reproduce state, quality, features, baseline, and core lineage at the referenced source ordinal.
hypotheses.success_metric: Exact reproduction for every sampled decision covered by the finalized source prefix, plus resolution of each cited source reference against a verified segment record.
limitations: Eight sampled decisions were beyond the captured finalized prefix and remain uncovered because their source segment was active.
Rolling history reference lists can differ when the offline replay does not reproduce the worker's runtime snapshot timing; every cited reference in the covered sample resolved to a source record.
The replay does not establish decision omissions, public fills, private queue position, market impact, or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Accept source reproducibility for the sampled finalized prefix. Continue to the market-quality and opportunity funnel; keep the protected campaign unchanged.

hypotheses.title: The observed raw campaign-window states contain no positive displayed complement
hypotheses.mechanism: If a source-receipt-time scan of every touched pair state shows no positive best-ask or full-depth pre-fee edge after quality filtering, the current sampled cohort has no observed gross opportunity to promote.
hypotheses.success_metric: Verify finalized source provenance; count touched market-frame states, quality reasons, full-depth quantity-five support, fee metadata coverage, and pre-fee edge distribution without exporting raw observations.
limitations: The captured source receipt window covered about 1 hour 58 minutes of the frozen fourteen-day campaign period.
Market-frame counts are repeated correlated observations and are not independent opportunity counts or venue-wide prevalence.
The scan uses source receipt time rather than replaying worker processing lag at every frame; its denominator differs from scheduled decision rows.
Displayed depth does not establish fills, and the scan did not apply fees, settlement, capital, or unmatched-position costs.
The active .open segment was excluded.
hypotheses.decision: Keep all policies at abstention for this evidence. Measure decision input lag and update cadence before drafting a separate future sampling design.

limitations: The receipt window covered about 2 hours 46 minutes of a fourteen-day campaign.
Repeated market-frame states are correlated and are not independent opportunities.
No fee, fill, settlement, or market impact outcome is inferred.

hypotheses.title: Paired-book freshness constrains more decisions than worker input lag
hypotheses.mechanism: If decision-to-source-frame lag stays within the frozen limit while the maximum age of either reconstructed outcome book often exceeds frozen freshness, data age at decision time is the leading measured quality constraint.
hypotheses.success_metric: Measure decision-to-frame input lag, maximum paired-book age, cross-outcome receiver-time skew, freshness violations, and quality reason by market for every sampled decision covered by a finalized source prefix.
limitations: This is one bounded campaign snapshot; repeated decisions by market are correlated and are not independent observations or venue-wide estimates.
Input lag is decision time minus the receiver timestamp of the cited raw frame; it does not measure upstream venue, network, or collector delay before that receipt.
Cross-outcome skew uses per-book source frame receiver timestamps. A zero difference can mean both outcomes were carried by one timestamped frame and does not establish venue-level simultaneity.
The timing scan identifies the age constraint but does not by itself determine whether it comes from market inactivity, source gaps, or decision scheduling.
Public depth and timing do not establish hypothetical fills, private queue position, market impact, or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the protected campaign unchanged. Measure per-market paired-book update intervals and compare source activity with the scheduled-decision denominator before designing any separate sampling cadence.

hypotheses.title: Scheduled stale decisions often cite frames with no update to their market
hypotheses.mechanism: If stale decisions usually reference a recent global frame that did not update the target market, freshness loss reflects asynchronous market activity and schedule alignment rather than worker processing lag alone.
hypotheses.success_metric: On one verified finalized-source snapshot, compare per-market outcome update intervals and discontinuities with the market outcomes updated in each scheduled decision frame and with paired-book freshness.
limitations: This is one bounded source and campaign snapshot; repeated decisions are correlated and do not represent venue-wide behavior.

Update interval quantiles are fixed-width bucket summaries. Intervals spanning a recorded source discontinuity, unsupported producer/reconstruction frame, or receiver-clock regression are censored and excluded from those summaries.
A decision-frame update count refers only to outcomes updated in the exact cited source frame; zero does not mean there was no update within the preceding freshness window.
Pooled per-market interval buckets do not retain time-block clustering; a high update count can coexist with stale scheduled decisions.
The 138 recorded book_resynchronization gaps were counted, but their affected issue labels have not yet been decomposed.
Public observations and displayed depth do not establish hypothetical fills, private queue position, market impact, or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the protected campaign unchanged. Align source activity and gap events to five-minute time blocks and scheduled decisions before proposing a separate cadence or any recorder change.

hypotheses.title: Resynchronization gap issue entries are predominantly labeled stale
hypotheses.mechanism: If source gap records repeatedly include stale issue labels, freshness state is a major correlate of recorded book_resynchronization events, although the aggregate affected-assets map does not identify the market or asset that triggered each reconnect.
hypotheses.success_metric: Align finalized-source book updates, scheduled decision freshness, five-minute time blocks, and normalized issue labels from gap records without exporting asset identifiers or raw payloads.
limitations: This is one bounded source and campaign snapshot; repeated decisions and source events are correlated and do not represent venue-wide behavior.
Affected issue counts are entries across gap records, not unique assets; the same asset can recur.
The affected_assets map includes issue-bearing books and does not identify which issue triggered a particular reconnect.
The five-minute freshness rate and gap count are descriptive and do not establish causation.
Frame-receiver timestamps do not identify upstream venue timing, and public source data do not establish fills or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Do not change the collector, campaign, or decision cadence from this aggregate result. Map gap issue entries to market IDs and time blocks, then compare those markets with update activity and inspect the recorded collector trigger settings.

hypotheses.title: Resynchronization issue entries concentrate in several stale-prone markets
hypotheses.mechanism: If gap issue entries map repeatedly to a subset of campaign markets whose scheduled decisions also violate freshness, inactivity or market-specific source behavior may contribute to reconnects; the all-issues map still does not identify the exact trigger.
hypotheses.success_metric: Map normalized affected issue entries in finalized source gap records to campaign market IDs and five-minute blocks, and compare issue-bearing markets with source update volume and scheduled freshness without exporting token identifiers.
limitations: This is one selected source and campaign snapshot; decisions and source events are correlated.
Gap records can list multiple campaign markets, so market-gap appearance counts overlap.
The affected_assets map lists all issue-bearing books and does not prove which market or issue triggered a reconnect.
Four markets had no mapped gap issue entries but their scheduled freshness rates varied; gap labels do not explain all stale decisions.
The currently loaded configuration is context and does not prove settings for every historical source gap.
Public observations do not establish fills or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: The v6/v7 follow-up mapped the affected outcomes and found stale issue age just above the active 60-second source threshold. This diagnostic is complete; do not change the collector or campaign.

hypotheses.title: Reported minimum order size must be checked against per-leg USDC notional
hypotheses.mechanism: Market minimumOrderSize is a USDC notional. Comparing it to share quantity can incorrectly pass orders whose displayed USDC amount remains below the venue minimum.
hypotheses.success_metric: Correctly evaluate each depth-walked leg's notional against its reported USDC minimum and preserve the prior v1 artifact unchanged.
limitations: No current positive candidate exercised the minimum threshold in the real source panel.
The corrected behavior is established by controlled test fixtures, not by a live order attempt.
hypotheses.decision: Keep v1 historical evidence intact and use v2 for future Veritas funnel analyses. No present opportunity conclusion changed because v1 also counted zero positive states.

hypotheses.title: Conditional binary economics must include fee exponents and buy-share deductions
hypotheses.mechanism: Applying a fixed exponent or subtracting buy fees as extra cash while retaining gross winning shares can misstate outcome-contingent P&L and entry capital.
hypotheses.success_metric: Verify per-market exponent math, both official rounding sensitivities, USDC notional minimums, buy-fee share equivalents, resolution-specific P&L, and partial-position payout bounds.

result.promotion: not promoted to a policy or campaign

limitations: Fee schedule inputs are not verified for every live market or historical fee activation date.
No private match counts, fills, or realized fees are available.
The controlled calculations do not establish strategy profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Retain the versioned engine for research scenarios; require a positive, quality-valid gross candidate and independent review before downstream use.

hypotheses.title: Displayed capacity can be economically diluted as hypothetical size increases
hypotheses.mechanism: Depth-weighted asks, per-leg minimums, fees, and carry assumptions can cause apparent small-size edge to disappear at larger sizes or under reduced displayed depth.
hypotheses.success_metric: Produce reproducible full-depth and half-depth size grids with per-leg costs, USDC capital frontiers, and outcome-specific P&L bounds while keeping fill probability unidentified.
limitations: The order book is synthetic and does not come from an observed opportunity.
The size grid is discrete and displayed depth does not guarantee fills.
FX conversion, order arrival, queue priority, market impact, and actual operating costs are unmeasured.
hypotheses.decision: Use the study to validate accounting and capacity reporting only; do not infer observed or scalable economic potential.

hypotheses.title: Are resynchronization issues asymmetric by outcome or explained by a startup configuration mismatch?
hypotheses.mechanism: If gap issues concentrate on one binary outcome or the recorded stale/resync thresholds differ from the campaign configuration, asymmetric source updates or configuration drift may explain some scheduled stale decisions.
hypotheses.success_metric: Map finalized issue entries to market and YES/NO outcome, compare source update interval buckets and scheduled freshness by market, and inspect allowlisted settings from finalized process-start records without exporting asset IDs.

result.promotion: diagnostic only; no collector, cadence, campaign, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: This is one bounded source and selected campaign snapshot; repeated decisions and issue entries are correlated.
Market-gap appearance counts overlap across gap records and do not represent unique reconnects or assets.
The issue map does not identify which issue triggered a resynchronization.
Intervals spanning source discontinuities are censored, and frame-receiver time is not venue quote time.
The last captured configured process start predates the campaign; it does not prove settings for every process state or identify causal behavior.
Public source measurements do not establish fills or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: The v7 event-age audit found no one-sided stale pattern or startup-threshold mismatch in this snapshot. Keep the frozen campaign and collector unchanged.

hypotheses.title: Do scheduled stale decisions fall between the campaign freshness gate and the source stale threshold?
hypotheses.mechanism: The frozen campaign rejects paired decisions when either book is older than five seconds, while the collector labels a source outcome stale after sixty seconds. Quantifying event-aligned outcome ages can distinguish quality-gate abstentions from source stale events.
hypotheses.success_metric: Measure same-recorded-gap-epoch receiver-time age from the previous outcome update to each stale gap entry and scheduled decision; compare with both frozen thresholds and retain missing, cross-gap, and nonmonotonic counts.

result.promotion: diagnostic only; no campaign, collector, cadence, policy, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: This is one bounded finalized source and selected campaign snapshot; repeated decisions and issue entries are correlated.
Elapsed ages use recorder receiver timestamps and do not measure upstream venue quote age or prove that a source update could have arrived sooner.
The source stale threshold and campaign decision freshness gate serve different purposes; this analysis does not establish that either setting should change.
The source gap record does not identify a counterfactual trigger or establish fills or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: The reconstructed stale issue timing matches the active 60-second source threshold. Most frozen 5-second freshness failures occurred below that threshold, with both outcomes aged together. Keep Reality unchanged and prioritize a separate, predeclared sampling/horizon study.

hypotheses.title: Does a longer finalized source prefix change the raw gross-opportunity conclusion?
hypotheses.mechanism: Additional finalized observations may reveal a quality-valid positive complementary edge absent in the earlier v2 snapshot; a larger count alone does not imply independent opportunities or execution.
hypotheses.success_metric: Re-run the versioned raw funnel on a later finalized prefix, checking paired-book quality, five-share displayed depth, fee metadata, minimum notionals, and top/full-depth gross edges.

result.promotion: no policy, opportunity, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: This is a selected monitored panel, not a venue-wide sample.
Repeated market-frame states are correlated and are not independent opportunities.
Displayed depth does not establish order arrival, queue priority, fills, or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: The later finalized prefix did not change the gross opportunity conclusion. Preserve the no-trade decision and quality gates; continue the predeclared horizon/sampling design and wait for a positive quality-valid gross candidate before expanding economics.

hypotheses.title: Can activity-stratified sampling improve synchronized public follow-up yield?
hypotheses.mechanism: Pre-period paired-book update activity may identify market strata with different public follow-up availability. Comparing a balanced activity-stratified sampler with a uniform random-market control may improve qualifying measurement yield per valid initial decision without relaxing source-quality rules.
hypotheses.success_metric: As refined in design draft 002, compare qualifying one-second public measurements per scheduled slot as the primary estimand; report yield among valid initial states as secondary, with eligibility, censor reasons, and cluster-aware uncertainty.

result.promotion: no campaign, policy, model, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: The initial one-day cohort is selected and small; its horizon rates are planning evidence, not a guarantee of future yield.
Activity stratification changes the sampled population and cannot be described as venue-wide prevalence.
Repeated observations are correlated and require cluster-aware planning and analysis.
A synchronized public measurement does not establish an execution or fill.
hypotheses.decision: Continue design refinement only. Use all scheduled slots for the primary yield and conditional valid-start yield only as secondary; freeze the eligible universe, coverage rule, assignment schedule, cluster-power calculation, and analysis before any separate campaign. Keep the no-trade control and all existing quality gates.

hypotheses.title: How high must paired completion be to offset an unmatched-leg loss?
hypotheses.mechanism: A hypothetical completed pair can have positive P&L under a favorable fee-rounding case while an unpaired leg loses its acquisition cost at settlement. Solving the break-even relationship shows the completion rate required to offset that loss without pretending public quotes identify fills.
hypotheses.success_metric: For explicit synthetic book, fee, carry, and adverse unmatched-leg assumptions, solve p * complete-pair P&L = q * unmatched-leg loss under single-match and fragmentation-safe fee cases; preserve p, q, and no-fill as unestimated scenarios.

result.promotion: synthetic arithmetic and break-even thresholds only; no strategy promotion

limitations: The order book, rates, fees, financing, and operating costs are controlled synthetic assumptions, not observed opportunities.
The unmatched leg is held to an adverse terminal outcome with zero recovery; no recovery route or execution probability is identified.
The positive single-match result depends on an optimistic fee-fragmentation sensitivity; the fragmentation-safe completed-pair P&L is negative in the tested grid.
Threshold rates are algebraic sensitivities and cannot be treated as estimated fill rates or expected real-world performance.
hypotheses.decision: Do not promote the synthetic positive single-match scenario. At 100 shares per leg, the favorable full-depth case would require about 35.4 matched completions per adverse unmatched event, while the fragmentation-safe pair result is already negative. Keep fill rates unknown and wait for a quality-valid observed gross candidate before using the engine for candidate-specific strategy comparison.

hypotheses.title: Was the failed Arena policy search still broken in the release baseline?
hypotheses.mechanism: A legacy tournament manifest omitted evaluation_generator; the captured policy-search source indexed the missing key while checking seed reuse.
hypotheses.success_metric: Compare the failed job source snapshot with release code, identify the introducing fix and regression coverage, and run the current focused policy-search tests without rerunning the old job.

result.promotion: historical root cause only; no current code change required

limitations: The original job was not rerun; the current regression exercises a legacy manifest fixture rather than the old job directory.
The failure predates the release baseline and does not demonstrate a current policy-search defect.
A separate Arena dataset job was cancelled at 384 of 1,001 episodes; the cancellation was not investigated as a code failure.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the release fallback and regression. Do not restart or edit the failed job artifact. Continue the broader Research Director and remaining one-shot service audit independently.

hypotheses.title: Were the Gate G backend and browser failures persistent Veritas defects?
hypotheses.mechanism: The backend integration test used a 180-second subprocess timeout around a plan job with a 300-second declared wall budget. The browser source-record label was absent once; Reality commit c96a031 then added lookup across .seg/.open rotation and the browser recheck passed.
hypotheses.success_metric: Classify each one-shot failure from captured logs and matching source, reproduce bounded backend work in the Veritas checkout, and preserve protected Reality artifacts and services.

result.browser_failure: Checksum-verified raw input record label absent within 5 seconds
result.promotion: bounded backend and isolated browser verification only; no campaign or strategy promotion
result.browser_regression_test: tests/test_reality_dashboard.py: .seg reference resolves while matching .open source exists
result.browser_root_cause: likely segment-rotation lookup bug; failed response was not captured

limitations: The original browser API response was not captured, so the rotation-lookup explanation remains likely rather than confirmed.
The isolated browser test intercepted operations and raw-record routes; source-record behavior is separately covered with temporary segment fixtures.
One optional PostgreSQL integration test was skipped because MIDAS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was not supplied.
hypotheses.decision: The corrected full backend suite and isolated browser checks pass. Treat the old browser failure as likely fixed by release commit c96a031, preserve its failed log and campaign, and make no protected campaign repair.

hypotheses.title: Was the 2026-10-14 shadow-canary failure caused by an empty finalized source segment?
hypotheses.mechanism: The frozen canary reader compared the last ordinal of a zero-record segment to the nonzero global source cursor after a populated segment with the same ordinal prefix.
hypotheses.success_metric: Match the failed worker source snapshot, exact cursor and catalog condition, identify a pre-release correction and regression, and verify that regression without replaying or modifying the failed campaign.

result.failing_condition: empty segment last=0 compared to global cursor=847
result.promotion: historical root cause only; fixed before release, no campaign repair or strategy promotion

limitations: The failed immutable canary was not restarted or replayed; the failure is classified from its journal trace, frozen source, status cursor, and matching segment catalog metadata.
Only the empty segment 8-byte framing header was hashed to rule out its checksum branch; populated raw segment record contents were not read.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the failed canary artifact and status unchanged. The released source skips last-ordinal comparison for empty segments, and its regression passes. Do not rerun the old frozen campaign to apply the fix.

hypotheses.title: Can the activity-aware follow-up comparison detect a meaningful yield improvement within 14 days?
hypotheses.mechanism: The earlier design used conditional yield among valid initial states as its primary measure. Activity-based market selection may also change initial-state validity, so the primary estimand should count qualifying one-second measurements per scheduled slot and preserve invalid starts as non-successes.
hypotheses.success_metric: Refine the primary estimand, calculate a declared relative minimum detectable lift, and determine whether a 14-day slot cap supports it under explicit cluster-dependence sensitivities without creating or starting a campaign.

result.promotion: planning sensitivity only; no prospective campaign or strategy promotion

limitations: The event rate is from one selected snapshot and may not remain stable.
No empirical market, time-block, family, or repeated-measure correlation is available in the current artifact set.
The single design-effect grid is not a substitute for exact schedule simulation under crossed dependence.
Higher public follow-up yield does not establish executable fills or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the protocol design-only. Do not freeze or start a separate campaign until finalized multi-day data establish the coverage gate and a design-specific power simulation fits the 14-day cap; retain the no-trade control and all existing quality gates.

hypotheses.title: Does a later finalized source prefix change the gross opportunity conclusion?
hypotheses.mechanism: A materially larger finalized public source prefix could reveal a quality-valid positive complementary edge that was absent in the preceding selected panel; repeated market-frame observations remain correlated and do not establish executable fills.
hypotheses.success_metric: Re-run the bounded version 2 opportunity funnel on a later finalized prefix and report source integrity, paired-book quality, five-share depth, per-leg USDC minimums, and top/full-depth pre-fee positive counts.

result.promotion: diagnostic only; no opportunity, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: This remains one selected monitored panel rather than a venue-wide sample.
Repeated market-frame states are correlated and are not independent opportunities.
Displayed depth does not establish order arrival, queue priority, fills, or profitability.
hypotheses.decision: The later finalized prefix did not change the gross opportunity conclusion. Preserve the no-trade decision and existing quality gates; wait for a materially larger interval before the next funnel replay and require multi-day evidence before considering a separate follow-up campaign.

hypotheses.title: Can the current Veritas branch pass full bounded Gate H verification?
hypotheses.mechanism: Independent backend, typing, lint, formatting, frontend build, and isolated browser checks can expose integration defects while keeping Reality service controls and source payloads outside the test path.
hypotheses.success_metric: Run the full backend suite, strict type checking, lint and format, frontend tests, typecheck and build, and isolated browser checks; retain the protected campaign identity.

result.promotion: engineering verification only; no opportunity, policy, campaign, strategy, or profitability promotion

limitations: The full backend suite ran before two final type-narrowing guards in scripts/research_followup.py; its 10 focused tests and strict Mypy passed after those guards.
PostgreSQL integration was skipped because MIDAS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was not supplied.
The isolated browser run intercepted operations and raw-record routes; raw-record backend behavior is tested with temporary segments.
The production build reports the existing main and chart chunks above 500 kB.
hypotheses.decision: Gate H verification passed within the recorded limits. Gate J closeout reports are complete; do not promote an opportunity, policy, campaign, strategy, or profitability claim.

hypotheses.title: Does the finalized observed panel support strategy or prospective campaign promotion?
hypotheses.mechanism: A source-verified positive gross candidate that survives quality, payoff, quantity, fee, and minimum-notional checks is a prerequisite for economic policy comparison; public evidence alone does not identify fills.
hypotheses.success_metric: Reconcile the latest observed funnel, synthetic economics, follow-up readiness, engineering checks, and protected-state boundary; report whether any candidate or separate campaign is justified.
limitations: The observed market panel and finalized interval are selected and short.
Observed states are correlated and are not independent opportunities.
Synthetic fee and unmatched-leg results are sensitivities, not actual money or empirical rates.
Actual fills, queue position, market impact, and profitability remain unknown.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the no-trade control. Do not select a strategy or start a separate prospective campaign. Continue multi-day source coverage work and revisit only after an independently checked positive gross candidate and a validated follow-up design.

hypotheses.title: Can Veritas reuse Arena research orchestration without duplicating job control?
hypotheses.mechanism: Typed Arena jobs, finite admission, resource gates, persisted status, and the native Research Director can supervise bounded simulator experiments; raw Veritas source analysis needs a separate typed worker only if repeated analyses justify one.
hypotheses.success_metric: Identify existing durable job and schedule controls, limits, UI/API routes, Veritas adapter gaps, and a promotion rule without starting services or jobs.
limitations: This is a source-code architecture review; it does not verify the host timer state.
The existing follow-up Director analyzes synthetic Arena tournaments, not Reality public-market follow-ups.
hypotheses.decision: Reuse the existing Arena controller for eligible simulator studies; defer a Veritas source-reading job until materially longer coverage or another preregistered repeated analysis justifies the adapter and its source-read tests.

hypotheses.title: The original paired-book freshness gate overcounts stale observations when quiet books return in a current batch
hypotheses.mechanism: A reported book timestamp can represent last update time, while a recently returned public batch has a separate request-to-receipt interval. Treating reported age as the only freshness clock may censor otherwise usable paired snapshots.
hypotheses.success_metric: Paired same-payload change in quality-valid pair yield, with batch duration and source-age limitations recorded.
limitations: This is a paired reclassification of the exact saved scan, not a new cohort.
A batch response does not verify atomicity, venue sequence, or upstream queue age.
The higher valid-pair yield is a measurement result and does not imply an economic candidate or fill.
hypotheses.decision: Use the repaired gate for this bounded snapshot pilot while retaining source age and skew diagnostics; require independent freshness evidence before candidate promotion.

hypotheses.title: A broader price-blind public discovery union can support a stratified rotating market panel
hypotheses.mechanism: Multiple bounded market query frames and deterministic sampling across liquidity, expiry, category, spread, and sampled snapshot change can widen the monitored cohort while retaining stable controls and explicit selection scope.
hypotheses.success_metric: Measure eligible query-union size, selected strata, stable/rotating observations, market diversity, valid-pair yield, exclusions, and bounded service cost.
limitations: The six-frame Gamma union is bounded and is not the venue-wide universe.
Rotating selection probabilities are conditional on the discovered union and frozen controls.
The early window is short and repeated market snapshots are dependent.
This separate snapshot pilot does not satisfy or bypass the specific prospective follow-up design gates.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the read-only timer active and collect a longer window; review dependence only after the stated temporal and diversity criteria are reached.

hypotheses.title: Depth, per-leg minimum, and fee checks do not reveal a positive candidate where the top-ask baseline is empty
hypotheses.mechanism: A verified qualification funnel should preserve the unchanged top-ask gross baseline, then separately require full displayed depth, both per-leg minimums, and fee sensitivities without introducing candidates through size or cost arithmetic.
hypotheses.success_metric: Compare top-ask positive states against 20-share full-depth, minimum-notional, single-match-fee, and fragmentation-safe-fee counts on the same finalized quality-valid observations.
limitations: This is candidate qualification, not a strategy PnL or fill experiment.
The selected public panel is short and correlated, not representative of the full venue.
Displayed depth and hypothetical fees do not establish persistence, order arrival, or execution.
hypotheses.decision: Keep no-trade as the current hypothetical policy. Continue the bounded observation and rerun a separately identified economic comparison when the evidence window materially grows.

hypotheses.title: The bounded timer advances finalized snapshot analysis once after a committed release
hypotheses.mechanism: A persistent user timer and oneshot service should append one immutable snapshot and one v2 analysis event per successful run without rewriting prior snapshot or event identities.
hypotheses.success_metric: Observe the post-commit systemd run exit status, new snapshot and event hashes, before/after processed counts, and residual analysis backlog.
limitations: One successful timer run is not evidence of long-term service reliability.
The next scheduled execution must be checked for timer continuity and bounded resource use.
hypotheses.decision: Keep the read-only timer active and continue checking immutable snapshot and event lineage as coverage accumulates.

hypotheses.title: A later scheduled observation retains the empty gross-to-economic qualification funnel
hypotheses.mechanism: If an additional price-blind selected snapshot remains non-positive at top ask, correct full-depth walk, both per-leg minimums, and separately reported fee sensitivities, it supplies no basis to promote a hypothetical strategy.
hypotheses.success_metric: Re-run frozen baseline and economic qualification rules over all ordered finalized v2 events with a deterministic dataset-derived run identity.
limitations: The seven-snapshot interval is about 32 minutes and remains short and correlated.
The study is candidate qualification rather than realized or hypothetical strategy PnL.
No fills, persistence, continuous coverage, or venue-wide prevalence are inferred.
hypotheses.decision: Keep no-trade and continue the bounded pilot; do not train a predictor or compare execution policies without qualifying candidates and appropriate outcome labels.

hypotheses.title: Bounded finalized Reality source replay advances and resumes without writer access
hypotheses.mechanism: A campaign-pinned incremental reader can reconstruct source context from finalized Reality segments in bounded batches while detecting catalog-prefix drift and recovering idempotently after interruption.
